notes.title: GRIMTALE ISLAND IS COMMING BACK
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I know you havent heard from me in a while but I needed to take some time to rebuild my life from previeous events that had happend witch I discussed in a previous news post.

But as the title suggests.. grimtale island is comming back!

This game has always been my passion and i am now finally back in a place where I can make it a reality.

The game was recently released from early access priced at under £1. This may have brought some questions to people's minds and I will now hopefully explain my reasoning behind this.

I didnt want to release another app where previous players would have to re buy the game at full price as I dont feel like this is fair and I am not a cash grab developer.
Also i want to give new players the chance to grab a copy while the game is cheap.

I look forward to showing you the new game. I will post updates on progress as soon as possible.

Thank you

Michael schade

notes.title: END OF DEVELOPMENT
notes.content:
Hello everyone...

First i would like to apologise for not updating you straight away, you will realise why shortly.

I would like to be 100% transparent in the reason why Grimtale island's development stopped, unfortunately my 6 years of marriage came to an end on October 30th 2018 and as you can all imagine with 3 young children this was some very difficult news to swallow for myself and my family. 

at this point in time there was no plans to end Grimtale islands development process and to be very honest there was no plans of much in this time, i moved out from my home to live back with my dad and with no money coming in i had to provide for my children and to do that i needed a full time job. at this time i was working on Grimtale island still to 1 try to keep my promise to you guys and 2 to keep my mind occupied on something other than the previous events.

unfortunately i realised i could not keep up development while seeing my children and holding down a full time job and had to choose what was most important to me... and a full time job with a regular income to support my kids was the obvious choice.

I'm sorry i could not keep my promise to you all and Grimtale island will always be a plan for the future but not as an early access title. 

to end, i would like to thank everybody who supported me and the game through the development process and who stayed when things got tough! 
you are all amazing!.

I will now make the current version of Grimtale Island Free to play, this may anger people who paid money for the game but i feel like this is the correct thing to do without removing the game from the library as i feel the game in its current state can still be enjoyed. 

thank you

michael schade

notes.title: WHATS NEXT?
notes.content:
Well guys... i would like to tell you what im currently working on for Grimtale island.

1. In Game currency - Gold (this will be in game only and not be obtained 
    through micro transactions)

2. Traders - there will be safe zones on each island that will home traders to buy 
    resourses from and even weapons.

3. Missions - Alongside Traders there will be People you can speak to for 
    missions, these missions will be rewarded in either Gold or resourses.

4. The large island - This island will be huge, think of it as the main map. 
    players of the old version of Grimtale island will know the size of the old map, 
    this one will be bigger. 

5. co-op - co-op multiplayer will be available early 2019

These are the things im currenyly working on (alongside polish of already implimented mechanics)

I hope you like the way the game is going and i hope to see more people explore Grimtale in the near future! 

thank you all! 

michael schade - lead developer

notes.title: MONTHLY UPDATES
notes.content:
Hello guys!

I have decided to do monthly updates instead of weekly, this may sound like bad news but i think it will be better..

Monthly updates will bring way more content to the game in the long run meaning instead of spending time testing builds each week i can work on adding more to the game. currently i will work non stop all day everyday and this is very hard with a wife a children so with monthly updates i can work normal hours and still have twice the ammount of work done each month. 

i hope you all can understand but i promise it will be better in the long run, to put it all into perspective on how much new content each monthly update will contain.... im looking to leave early access in january! (game will still be supported after that time)

thank you all

michael schade - Lead (and only) Developer

notes.content:

* Loot spawns will no longer be predictable and will have a wider variety of loot.

* Animation blend.... unfortunately I was unable to get the the stage of adding animation blends to the current animations but am now happy to announce that all animations have blends to them. 

* No more art style clash between assets. I realise that certain assets in the old version of Grimtale island did not match the art style. All new assets are going to suit the art style. 


* Farming will be a focal point in survival this time around 

* WHOLE NEW INVENTORY SYSTEM!!!! 
   ( Drag and drip system)


More info to come

notes.title: SUNDAYS UPDATE (INFORMATION)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

As you all know, there hasn’t been the usual update every couple of days for a little while. This is because I have been working on a brand new map and improved game mechanics.

The new map will replace the old map but will be a thousand times better in every way! You are placed on an actual island this time surrounded by ocean for a more immersive expeariance.

Here are the new features!

* A new world, build from the ground up, 4 times as big as the old map.

* dynamic fishing in lakes and rivers! 

* Farming that uses the worlds solar and weather systems to decide your crops      
  fate.

* Craftable axe (no longer a pickup) 

* Random loot spawns based on item rating system.

* zombie spawn based on noise and player location.

* zombie horde events (random zombie hordes will spawn and follow randomly generated paths, lets hope your not in the middle of it.

* painted terrain for a more detailed look

* land, water and air vehicles 

* double the performance of the old build!

I can’t wait and I hope you guys can’t either!

Thank you all for being so patient!

notes.title: HORDE MODE (DETAILS)
notes.content:
Hello! 

I wanted to share a little more about the Horde mode that will soon be implemented into Grimtale Island.

WHAT IS IT? 

Horde mode is a wave based game mode where you, the player will fight your way through multiple waves of Stalkers in increasing difficulty.

MAPS 

There will be 3 different maps for this game mode.

Military base - The walls have been breached and it’s now up to you to go down fighting! 

Hilltop - You are the king of the hill and it’s down to you to stay that way.

Town - fight in cramped spaces and open areas! This map will give a lot of variety.


WHEN WILL IT RELEASE? 

I am hopeing to get this game mode out this Friday! 

There will only be one map included in the first implementation of this game mode, This will be military base.

notes.title: STABILITY, BUG FIXES AND HORDE MODE!

In this update i have improoved the stability of Grimtale island while fixing some very annoying bugs. Horde mode is now a displayed option in the menu and will be comming in the next couple of weeks!

  M16 Bullets, at the cost of 10 metal.

* Fixed bug where jelly fish would swim above water.

* Fixed bug where picking 9mm ammo would sometimes not give the player 
  the ammo.

* Removed Tree collision of Trees that are unreachable.

* Lowerd Hunger and thirst rate by a small ammount

* Added Eating and Drinking animations to HUD 

* Crosshair Animation added when player is walking.

* Main menu Fly in and out animations added.

* Mode select Screen fade in animations added.

notes.title: UPDATE 2 ( NEW BUILD SYSTEM, HOTBAR, ANIMATIONS)
notes.content:
[u]NOTE THIS UPDATE WILL REQUIRE A NEW GAME, THIS WONT BE THE CASE IN THE FUTURE.[/u] 

[h1]NEW BUILDING SYSTEM[/h1] 

 I have changed the way the base building works in Grimtale Island. 
 now when you place an item you will go into build mode, this means that you 
 can full look around and place an item exactly where you need it.

 * Buildable items will now snap to any surface you place them on ( no more 
   spawning under the ground or in a tree trunk)

 * Press R to rotate items

 * Left mouse to Place item.

You will see a red square and a red line when in build mode this will eventually be changed to a more pleasing effect.

[h1]HOTBAR[/h1] 

* No more changing weapons, eating or drinking in the Inventory! (YAY!!!!)

* When you pick up a weapon, the weapon will automaticaly be placed on 
  your hot bar.

* Hot bar will detect if you have drink and food in inventory (only apples can 
  be eaten from hotbar at the moment)

[h1]CHANGE WEAPON ANIMATIONS[/h1] 

* When you change a weapon on your hot bar it will play an animation and 
  will stop player from using weapon for a short period untill the player has the 
  weapon equipt 


[u]FROM THIS POINT ON, UPDATES WILL CONTAIN MORE CONTENT AND FIXES, THESE UPDATES I FELT HAD TO BE PUT OUT EARLYER FOR THE ENJOYMENT OF THE GAME[/u]

notes.title: Performance Patch
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I have some Great news regarding Grimtale Islands Performance.
 
People with lower end systems should see a major improvemet in FPS while playing Grimtale Island.

The reason people where having fps drops was because the whole map was being renderd at all times no matter where the player was, this has now been changed and the map will only render objects at a certain distance from the player. This will be inplimented as a view distance slider in the graphics menu at a later date. 

(FOR THIS PATCH TO TAKE EFFECT PLAYERS WILL NEED TO START A NEW GAME)

thank you 

Michael Schade - Developer
